name: Linux Foundation Certified IT Associate
name_ja: Linux Foundation 認定 IT アソシエイト

formal: No prerequisites; intended as a beginner-level IT associate credential

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Distribution-neutral beginner IT coverage provides an entry technical foundation from a recognized issuer; zero experience, knowledge-only testing and limited uptake do not support applied associate standing.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Distribution-neutral beginner IT coverage under proctoring supports foundational infrastructure knowledge. Zero experience, multiple-choice assessment and limited uptake do not establish associate system-administration capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded distribution-neutral IT scope is technical entry groundwork despite the Associate title. No experience and a multiple-choice examination do not demonstrate Linux administration delivery.
